# The session domain

The one running sketch a host holds: opening it, pinning what a repeatable run needs pinned, photographing it, and reading back what its last frame cost.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Namespace in the definition | sigil.protocol.session |
| What a host implements | `sigil::protocol::session::SessionAgent`, mounted by `sigil::protocol::session::wire` |
| C++ client | `sigil::protocol::session::SessionClient` |
| Events sent through | `sigil::protocol::session::SessionEvents` |
| Python client | sigil.protocol.session.Session |

## Commands

### session.open

Opens a sketch by registry name or by path, replacing the session open, and answers once its first frame is drawn.

In Python, Session.open.

Answered later, through the reply the agent is handed, once the work is done.

Takes `OpenParameters`: What open is asked.

| Parameter | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sketch` | string, required | "" | A registry name, or the path to a sketch file or directory, which is compiled and loaded as a person's edit would be. |
| `kind` | string | "" | The runtime to open it through, canvas or set; empty for whichever it declares. |

Answers `Summary`: A session as a list shows it.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sketch` | string | "" | The registry name, or the path, it was opened from. |
| `kind` | string | "" | The runtime it draws through: canvas or set. |
| `width` | float | 0.0 | The canvas width it declared, in canvas units. |
| `height` | float | 0.0 | The canvas height it declared, in canvas units. |
| `moment` | double | -1.0 | The moment it declared it is photographed at, in seconds; negative where it declared none. |

### session.pinDevice

Pins the device the session draws with.

In Python, Session.pin_device.

Answered at once.

Takes `DeviceParameters`: What pinDevice is asked.

| Parameter | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `device` | Device (enumeration) | Cpu | The device the session draws with from now on. |

Answers nothing but that it was done.

### session.pinPromotion

Pins when the runtime may re-bake a node it was not asked to.

In Python, Session.pin_promotion.

Answered at once.

Takes `PromotionParameters`: What pinPromotion is asked.

| Parameter | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `promotion` | Promotion (enumeration) | Auto | When the runtime may re-bake from now on. |

Answers nothing but that it was done.

### session.still

Photographs the session at the clock as it stands.

In Python, Session.still.

Answered later, through the reply the agent is handed, once the work is done.

Takes `StillParameters`: What still is asked.

| Parameter | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `density` | double | 1.0 | Device pixels per canvas unit. |
| `path` | string | "" | Where the still is written, under the state root; empty for a name the host picks. |

Answers `StillResult`: The still, written.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | "" | Where it was written. |
| `width` | uint | 0 | Its width in pixels. |
| `height` | uint | 0 | Its height in pixels. |
| `seconds` | double | 0.0 | Clock seconds when it was taken. |

### session.sequence

Photographs frames one after another, stepping the clock between them.

In Python, Session.sequence.

Answered later, through the reply the agent is handed, once the work is done.

Takes `SequenceParameters`: What sequence is asked.

| Parameter | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `frames` | uint | 1 | Frames to photograph, one after another. |
| `rate` | double | 60.0 | Frames per second the clock advances between them. |
| `density` | double | 1.0 | Device pixels per canvas unit. |
| `directory` | string | "" | The directory the frames are written into, under the state root; empty for one the host picks. |

Answers `SequenceResult`: The frames, written.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `paths` | list of string | empty | Where each frame was written, in order. |
| `width` | uint | 0 | Each frame's width in pixels. |
| `height` | uint | 0 | Each frame's height in pixels. |

### session.timing

How the last frame split.

In Python, Session.timing.

Answered at once.

Takes nothing.

Answers `TimingResult`: How the last frame split.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `total_milliseconds` | double | 0.0 | Everything the frame cost, in milliseconds. |
| `update_milliseconds` | double | 0.0 | What the sketch's own body did. |
| `draw_milliseconds` | double | 0.0 | What its runtime then did with what the body described. |
| `lanes` | list of LaneCost (table) | empty | What each lane cost; empty for a runtime that keeps no breakdown. |

### session.measured

The numbers the sketch measured about its own execution.

**Experimental**: its shape may still change.

In Python, Session.measured.

Answered at once.

Takes nothing.

Answers `MeasuredResult`: The numbers a sketch measured about its own execution.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `values` | list of MeasuredValue (table) | empty | Each one, in the order the sketch measured them. |

### session.compositeCounts

Counts the composites each pixel of the next frame passes through, and answers the plane once that frame is drawn.

In Python, Session.composite_counts.

Answered later, through the reply the agent is handed, once the work is done.

Takes nothing.

Answers `CompositeCountsResult`: The composite-count plane of the next frame.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | "" | Where the plane was written, under the state root: one saturating byte per device pixel, as a grey image. |
| `width` | uint | 0 | The plane's width in pixels. |
| `height` | uint | 0 | The plane's height in pixels. |
| `maximum` | uint | 0 | The most composites any one pixel passed through. |

### session.enable

Starts this client's session events.

In Python, Session.enable.

Answered by the dispatcher itself, never by the agent: it starts or stops this client's session events.

### session.disable

Stops this client's session events.

In Python, Session.disable.

Answered by the dispatcher itself, never by the agent: it starts or stops this client's session events.

## Events

What the session tells a client that enabled it.

### session.opened

A session opened, by a client or by a person.

In Python, Session.on_opened.

Carries `OpenedEvent`: A session opened.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `summary` | Summary (table), required | absent | The session. |

### session.closed

The session closed.

In Python, Session.on_closed.

Carries `ClosedEvent`: A session closed.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sketch` | string | "" | The registry name, or the path, it was opened from. |

### session.failed

A session could not be opened, or rebuilt after an edit.

In Python, Session.on_failed.

Carries `FailedEvent`: A session could not be opened, or could not be rebuilt after an edit.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sketch` | string | "" | The registry name, or the path, it was asked for. |
| `message` | string | "" | What stopped it, in the compiler's or the runtime's own words. |

## Types

### Device

What a session draws with.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `Cpu` | Skia's raster backend: the reference every plate is judged against. |
| `Gpu` | The GPU, through the host's device. |

### Promotion

When the runtime may re-bake a node it was not asked to.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `Off` | Never: a byte-identical still asks for this. |
| `Auto` | By the runtime's own measure of what is expensive, which differs from machine to machine. |
| `Eager` | Every node the runtime may bake, whatever it costs. |

### LaneCost

What one lane of a frame cost, named by the runtime that spent it.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | "" | The lane, in the runtime's own word. |
| `milliseconds` | double | 0.0 | Milliseconds it spent. |

### MeasuredValue

One number a sketch measured about its own execution.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | "" | The name the sketch gave it. |
| `value` | double | 0.0 | The value it measured. |
| `pinned` | double | 0.0 | The value a repeatable run shows in its place. |
